name: tris-res-street
js: (async () => { const a = window.__CITY_APP; let best = { triangles: 0 }; for (let k = 0; k < 12; k++) { await new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(r)); const i = a.renderer.info; if ((i.render && i.render.triangles || 0) >= best.triangles) best = { triangles: i.render.triangles, calls: i.render.drawCalls, frameCalls: i.render.calls }; } let trees = null, inst = 0, meshes = 0; a.scene.traverse((o) => { if (o.name === "Trees" && !trees) trees = o; }); if (trees) trees.traverse((o) => { if (o.isInstancedMesh && o.visible && o.count) { inst += o.count; meshes++; } }); return { ...best, rafSamples: 12, treeInstancesDrawn: inst, treeMeshes: meshes, lidarTrees: window.CITY.lidarTrees ? window.CITY.lidarTrees.stats : null }; })()
